findings.reason: the split nodes must know whether the original is one of the compared targets or must be emptied, and implementing §2 literally would either force every definition out of the original (contradicting §8) or fail every split on a false "lost" report.
findings.text: §2's move check requires every non-import top-level statement of the base module to appear byte-identically "in exactly one produced module", but §8 (line 149) says the original module "keeps whatever the map leaves in it", and the script passes the original path separately from "the module paths a split produced"; a definition legitimately retained in the original therefore appears in no produced module and is reported lost, so a split done exactly as §8 permits fails `check_pure_move` and §3–§7's done-when

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — resolved against the worktree: `_context_fit_verdict` and `_tokens_for_bytes` (with `_CONTEXT_BYTES_PER_TOKEN = 3.5`, `_MEASURED_LAUNCH_CONTEXT_FLOOR_TOKENS = 50_392`) in `reckon/crew/routing.py`; `read_sources` in `reckon/velocity.py` with the cited `(repo, revision, *, prefix=...)` signature; `read_trees` in `reckon/interface_counts.py` built on `read_sources`; `definitions` lists only functions/classes; `_import_targets` in `reckon/served_code.py`; `docs/state/reckon/shared-write-paths.json` lists all four cited modules; `tests/test_staged_write_inventory.py` overlays working bytes over `read_trees` as cited; `/reckon/plans/the-fleet-moves-to-a-new-node` exists; the §1 token table and the decision rationale's five files all reproduce at the cited revision `6891282e9` (dispatch 153,185; recovery 149,235; promotion 115,748; cli 100,720; mcp 59,351; runs 52,403; _backends 50,172; tests/test_crew 49,746; ledger 43,522; serve 43,373; routing 43,118; budget 41,496).
rubric_items.done_when: pass — each section's done-when is measurable and names a control that can fail: §2 requires a fixture file over the bound outside the allowlist and an allowlisted fixture under it each to turn the guard red, and three `check_pure_move` fixtures to exit non-zero; §3–§7 measure the whole suite by delta against a base and the guard's ratchet; §4 adds the byte-identical help-text comparison at base and head. No node's measure holds regardless of the code.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — every artifact path is durable and inside the repository: §3–§6 maps under `docs/evidence/fragments/every-module-fits-a-worker-window/`, new test and script files under `tests/` and `scripts/`, and no gate log or receipt is written to a session scratchpad or node-local temporary path.
rubric_items.naming: pass — the produced sibling modules are named for the concern each holds and §8 forbids a part number, a version or the word *core*; the new files (`scripts/check_pure_move.py`, `tests/test_every_module_fits_a_worker_window.py`, `tests/test_check_pure_move.py`) carry no plan label, stage name or ticket number, and the plan-slug evidence directory is an output artifact, not a symbol.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — §2's move check and §8 disagree on whether the original module may retain definitions; §2 requires every non-import top-level statement of the base module to appear "in exactly one produced module", while §8 says the original "keeps whatever the map leaves in it". The root cause (module size) matches the measured split of `_context_fit_verdict` into a launch floor plus whole-file write-path inputs, and each section's mechanism otherwise produces its done-when; but this one contradiction would send the move nodes down the wrong path.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §3–§7 name one deliverable each (a split (and, for §3–§6, its map) as two nodes, a per-module move for §7); §2 carries two labelled deliverables, but they share one closeable done-when and one verdict (see note under reasoning), so the section closes on a single verdict rather than splitting its gate.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — the plan declares `plan-standalone` with an explicit reason (no blocks edge or gate on the-fleet-moves-to-a-new-node §6 is true, since that §6 can run on a larger window or after §3/§4 land). No depends-on/informs/gates is missing: the cited fleet plan carries section-declarations only and no cross-plan edge on either side, and the absence of the edge is itself reasoned, not omitted.
